name: Pet shop fish room and reptile equipment

comps.spec: Central air blower or large linear air pumps feeding every tank
comps.loc: Under the tank racks or in a back room

comps.spec: Submersible and inline pumps, 10–200W, mains (some 12/24V DC)
comps.loc: Sumps under the racks and display tanks

comps.spec: UV-C steriliser lamps, 9–55W, in sealed units — burns eyes and skin when lit outside the housing
comps.loc: In the filter plumbing of the rack system

comps.spec: Activated carbon filter media, often sealed bags on the shelves
Filter sponges, floss and canister filters
Glass tanks, 4–12 mm panes held with silicone — cut the silicone to free the panes
Reptile heat mats and ceramic heat emitters, 25–150W
Reptile and aquarium thermostats with probes
Silicone airline tubing, PVC pipe and fittings
Plastic tubs, buckets and sump tanks
comps.loc: Under the racks and in the back room

notes: Food and medicine go first; the pumps, air blowers and carbon usually stay. Tanks of stagnant water may be foul: wear gloves.
